# Convolo AI

Convolo.ai is an AI-powered communications platform designed to enhance sales calls and improve conversion rates through rapid lead response and integration capabilities.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/convolo-ai/.

## Actions

- **Create Character**: Create a new character.
- **Define or Update Character Actions**: Define or update the list of actions a character can perform.
- **Generate Starter Conversation** (read-only): Generate starter conversation suggestions for a character.
- **Get Character Response** (read-only): Generate a response from a ConvAI character based on text or audio input.
- **List Voices** (read-only): Retrieve the list of available voice types.
- **Set Core AI Settings**: Set core AI settings for a character.
- **Update Character**: Update existing character details.
- **Update Character Backstory**: Update a character's backstory.
- **Evaluate Character Performance** (read-only): Evaluate a character's performance based on interactions.
- **Upload Knowledge Bank File**: Upload a knowledge bank file.
